# Pitchfork-and-Torch independent LP research notebook

Pinned source: https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/liber-research/tree/86fa55a5f43f9f2f71a627aa0c4a636903f9d61b (MIT, September 2026 reports; third-party notes, not Cicada material). README disclaims new plaintext and omits attack scripts, rune dump, JPEGs and raw outputs. Useful pointers: [family rollup](https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/liber-research/blob/86fa55a5f43f9f2f71a627aa0c4a636903f9d61b/notes/burned-2026-08-14.md), [cross-height rail](https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/liber-research/blob/86fa55a5f43f9f2f71a627aa0c4a636903f9d61b/notes/cross-height-rail-pass1.md), [homophonic solver](https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/liber-research/blob/86fa55a5f43f9f2f71a627aa0c4a636903f9d61b/notes/homophonic-zkd-pass1.md), [word-book](https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/liber-research/blob/86fa55a5f43f9f2f71a627aa0c4a636903f9d61b/notes/wordbook-pass1.md), [wing/tree](https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/liber-research/blob/86fa55a5f43f9f2f71a627aa0c4a636903f9d61b/notes/wing-tree-leaf-order-pass1.md), [sexagesimal key](https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/liber-research/blob/86fa55a5f43f9f2f71a627aa0c4a636903f9d61b/notes/sexagesimal-block-key-pass1.md).

Scope qualifications: word-book splits line wraps (3,316 vs corrected 2,896 groups) and includes partly nonprose WELCOME/KOAN donor controls; wing/tree reports 228 runes on physical p32 (actual 121); sexagesimal report places the p49–51 panel at onion 32–34. The reported heuristics are not independently reproducible from this notebook alone. Do not import their negatives as authoritative coverage of corrected physical scopes. A [stronger order-free homophone gate](../../im-results/lp2-opening-unordered-homophone-fdelete.md) tests the combined homophony/transposition model exactly at the necessary-condition level without reusing their parser.
